title: Epidemiologists
description: Investigate and describe the determinants and distribution of disease, disability, or health outcomes. May develop the means for prevention and control.

tasks.text: Communicate research findings on various types of diseases to health practitioners, policy makers, and the public.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Reports drafted; presentations need human delivery

dwas.name: Prepare scientific or technical reports or presentations.
Communicate with government agencies.
dwas.gwa_name: Coordinating the Work and Activities of Others

tasks.text: Oversee public health programs, including statistical analysis, health care planning, surveillance systems, and public health improvement.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Directing healthcare programs carries clinical accountability

dwas.name: Direct medical science or healthcare programs.

tasks.text: Investigate diseases or parasites to determine cause and risk factors, progress, life cycle, or mode of transmission.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Literature and data aided; lab work human

tasks.text: Educate healthcare workers, patients, and the public about infectious and communicable diseases, including disease transmission and prevention.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Technical procedure training needs live demonstration and correction

dwas.name: Train personnel in technical or scientific procedures.

tasks.text: Monitor and report incidents of infectious diseases to local and state health agencies.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Drafting agency communications aided; relationships human

dwas.name: Communicate with government agencies.
dwas.gwa_name: Coordinating the Work and Activities of Others

tasks.text: Plan and direct studies to investigate human or animal disease, preventive methods, and treatments for disease.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Research planning needs domain expertise and feasibility

dwas.name: Direct medical science or healthcare programs.

tasks.text: Provide expertise in the design, management and evaluation of study protocols and health status questionnaires, sample selection, and analysis.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Methods drafted; methodological rigor human

dwas.name: Develop methods of social or economic research.

tasks.text: Write articles for publication in professional journals.
tasks.rationale: text generation — AI drafts; original expertise and authorship are human

dwas.name: Write articles, books or other original materials in area of expertise.

tasks.text: Identify and analyze public health issues related to foodborne parasitic diseases and their impact on public policies, scientific studies, or surveys.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Statistical analysis of health data; clinician verifies

tasks.text: Write grant applications to fund epidemiologic research.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Draft grant text; human owns strategy and budget

dwas.name: Prepare proposals or grant applications to obtain project funding.

tasks.text: Plan, administer and evaluate health safety standards and programs to improve public health, conferring with health department, industry personnel, physicians, and others.
tasks.rationale: text generation — AI drafts standards; committee consensus and authority human

dwas.name: Establish standards for products, processes, or procedures.
dwas.gwa_name: Drafting, Laying Out, and Specifying Technical Devices, Parts, and Equipment

dwas.name: Direct medical science or healthcare programs.

tasks.text: Conduct research to develop methodologies, instrumentation, and procedures for medical application, analyzing data and presenting findings.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — AI researches and synthesizes; human judges relevance

dwas.name: Research topics in area of expertise.

tasks.text: Consult with and advise physicians, educators, researchers, government health officials and others regarding medical applications of sciences, such as physics, biology, and chemistry.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Healthcare advice carries liability; human owns it

dwas.name: Advise others on healthcare matters.
dwas.gwa_name: Providing Consultation and Advice to Others

tasks.text: Supervise professional, technical, and clerical personnel.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Technical supervision requires judgment and accountability

tasks.text: Teach principles of medicine and medical and laboratory procedures to physicians, residents, students, and technicians.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Science instruction content AI-assisted; delivery human

dwas.name: Instruct college students in physical or life sciences.

tasks.text: Prepare and analyze samples to study effects of drugs, gases, pesticides, or microorganisms on cell structure and tissue.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Biological sample analysis needs wet-lab execution

emerging_tasks.task: Teach epidemiology to students in public health programs.
